Dunken, or 38 miles southeast of Ruidoso, moving east at 5 mph.

not attempt to drive through areas where water covers the roadway.

high tides.

* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands.

* IMPACTS...Minor to moderate flooding of sea water is likely
over vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the
time of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike

erosion is likely. Isolated damage of structures due to sea
water inundation is possible to the most vulnerable areas.

astronomical projections. The highest tides will be Monday
through Wednesday. There is a small chance for isolated
Coastal Flood Warnings Wednesday through Thursday if larger
surf develops. The Coastal Flood Advisory may also need to be
extended beyond Thursday.
properties.instruction:

NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

properties.description:
A trough moving over the state should bring abundant tropical
moisture and is expected to remain nearly stationary for a few days.
Heavy rain and isolated thunderstorms are possible, potentially
leading to flooding across all islands.

* WHERE...All main Hawaiian Islands.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through late Wednesday night.

* IMPACTS...Flood prone roads and other low lying areas may be closed
due to elevated runoff and overflowing streams. Urban areas may
receive more significant flooding and property damage due to rapid
runoff.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Heavy showers and isolated thunderstorms with intense rain rates
may develop Tuesday and continue through Wednesday evening as a
trough moves over the state.

should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 26 at 3:22AM EDT until October 29 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 6 to
8 feet. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip currents.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, moderate to possibly major
flooding around times of high tide. For the Coastal Flood
Advisory, minor flooding expected around times of high tide.

* WHERE...Southeast Georgia Beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 8 AM EDT Wednesday.
For the High Rip Current Risk, through late Wednesday night.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 11 AM EDT Tuesday. For
the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 11 AM Tuesday to 2 AM EDT
Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur. Dangerous
swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach erosion. Rip
currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into
deeper water.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.
